reconstruction.roadFit: Unoccluded 1 m DSM road pixels; cubic at the bridge, sampled slopes at approaches. Fit residual is not measurement accuracy.
reconstruction.horizontalTransform: PROJ OSTN15 OSGB36/WGS84 transformation with the recorded grid; 1 m declared horizontal accuracy.
reconstruction.verticalDatum: Source metre heights relative to the sampled dry bank; the TIFF does not declare an explicit vertical CRS. No absolute datum conversion is assumed.
reconstruction.retainingWalls: OSM ways 172233193,172233195,855452310; extent ends at native X -24 and +23. Masonry thickness, house-side pavement limits and individual courses are reconstructed.

limitations: Arch stations, pier elevations, stone arrangements and minor roof details are reconstructed from primary photographs, not survey geometry.
